caption: Adolph had already lost two-thirds of its births before Hitler became chancellor in 1933. #Adolph #NameHistory #AIVoice
pinned_comment: Did you expect the decline to begin in 1917?
story_thesis: Adolph peaked at 673 boys in 1917 and had already fallen 67 percent by 1933, the year Hitler took power, and never recovered.
script: This name was already dying before 1933. Adolph peaked at 673 American boys in 1917. By the time Hitler took power it was 222, down sixty-seven percent. Watch the fall start early.
